recognize_zh: 大體標本可見小腸壁內白色、魚肉狀的腫瘤塊；H&E 為一致性的中等大小淋巴球瀰漫成片，細胞形態單調、核圓深染，符合單形性上皮向性腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤（原 EATL type II）。
features: Gross: resected bowel segment with a white-tan, fleshy, homogeneous transmural mass
Diffuse sheets of monomorphic small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round, hyperchromatic nuclei with rim of pale/clear cytoplasm
Little pleomorphism and no conspicuous inflammatory background or necrosis in this field
describe_en: Gross photograph shows a resected segment of intestine containing a large, white-tan, fleshy, homogeneous mass expanding the bowel wall. Histologic section shows diffuse sheets of monomorphic small-to-medium-sized lymphoid cells with round hyperchromatic nuclei and a rim of pale cytoplasm, without significant pleomorphism or mixed inflammatory infiltrate. Epitheliotropism cannot be assessed in this field. With appropriate immunophenotype (typically CD3+, CD8+, CD56+, often TCR gamma-delta or alpha-beta), findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma (formerly EATL type II).

ddx.vs: EATL is pleomorphic with large anaplastic cells, a rich inflammatory background, CD56 negativity and association with celiac disease.
Shows angiocentric growth with necrosis and is EBER positive, whereas MEITL is EBV negative.

ddx.dx: Burkitt or other B-cell lymphoma of the bowel
ddx.vs: Burkitt has a starry-sky pattern and B-cell markers with MYC rearrangement; MEITL is CD3+ CD20- with no starry sky.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Involves mucosa superficially with small cells and low Ki-67 without forming a destructive transmural mass.
